posts.title: Travel Photography Is About People: How to Connect, Approach Strangers, and Make Photographs That Matter
posts.description: For nineteen years, Strobist has been about light. This post is about the other thing, the bigger thing, the thing that took me forty years and ten thousand assignments to fully understand. The success or failure of a travel photographer is not decided by gear, and only partly by technique. It is decided by how well you connect with the people and places in front of your camera. posts.title: The Traveling Photographer’s Manifesto,Discounted for Strobist Readers
posts.description: For fifteen years, this site focused on lighting. Before that, I worked as a newspaper photojournalist. Lighting was part of the job. So were access, preparation, and learning how to walk into unfamiliar situations and come back with something useful. Lighting solves technical problems. The harder problems are usually human. posts.title: The X-Peditions Workshops Site has Moved!
posts.description: Two pieces of news, on the X-Peditions Hanoi photo workshops front: The first is that I retired from teaching as of November 2025. But X-Peditions is still going strong.
